entries.test: serializes concurrent keepHistory and disconnectOnly checkpoints
entries.evidence: Failed on Linux three times: run 40485647652 (scheduled, main @7c53c12a17) and run 40517494613 (dispatch, main @ddc2a7827f), both with DaemonConnectionLostError: Disconnected out of disconnectOnly() at the test's own line 292, and again in run 40675428994 (scheduled 2026-10-28, main @7b86cb08), where local/check-unit-shard-verdict.mjs absorbed it as an already-triaged red. PASSED 17/17 in run 40540799557 (dispatch, branch nplez1/Fork-Opt-P2 @e2f7f28789) and again in runs 40695078222 and 40701735011 (main @1776dcc575, all five shards green), so it is intermittent rather than deterministic — and the second of those passes is not yet the two consecutive green nightlies the exit condition asks for. Passes 3/3 on this Mac too, so it is not a Mac allowlist entry either. Every file in the stack is upstream-owned with zero fork hunks: daemon-pty-event-subscriptions.ts, daemon/client.ts, daemon-client-pending-requests.ts, daemon-pty-adapter.ts and the test itself. Not fixable inside the fork without divergence, which costs more at the next sync than the red costs now.
